summary: Centerspace (CSR) filed an 8-K disclosing the outcome of its Board-led strategic review. The Board approved a portfolio optimization and deleveraging plan targeting ~$240–245M in asset sales of twelve communities in 2026, including a full exit from Bismarck and Rapid City markets and one Denver property. All disposals are under contract, subject to closing conditions, with expected closings in H2 2026. No advisor is named. The plan aims to enhance portfolio quality, strengthen the balance sheet, and preserve shareholder value. Watch for completion of sales and potential further strategic actions to reduce leverage or reposition the REIT.
